comparison.objective: Fit elbows to copper and plastic pipes, inserting a support sleeve only in the plastic pipe.
comparison.physical_skill: Perform three ordered coaxial push insertions selected by pipe material.
comparison.success_condition: Both elbows are seated and the plastic joint contains its insert; inserting into copper or first seating plastic without its insert causes failure. No separate spec versions are available.
comparison.reason: Ordered push-fit insertion is a different tested ability from captive fastener manipulation, rotary tuning, and impact validation.
